question.text: CAGR (Compound Annual Growth Rate) calculation formula:

explanation.text: The Logic: CAGR = (A/P)^(1/t) - 1, where A = terminal value, P = initial, t = years. Same as geometric mean return. The Trap: (A - P)/P gives total return; sum/t is arithmetic mean. Cross-Exam Context: Standard formula across all NISM exams. Manager's Pro-Tip: CAGR smooths volatility — useful for client communication but hides drawdowns. Pair with max drawdown for honest reporting.
